summary: Article 'School, Dances and Athletics Build Character in C.C.C. Camp' describes CCC Company No. 275 at State Park Camp No. 16 near the Cooper River Parkway (Erlton), under new commander Captain Wiese, running education classes, a Leaders Club, and dances; racial makeup of the company is not stated on the page, so the expected Black-press connection could not be confirmed from this text. Page is otherwise dominated by unrelated Camden fire, politics, and crime news.
